caption: Each row lists one non-overlapping 2×2 window of the 4×4 input and marks its largest value. The four maxima form the 2×2 output in reading order: row 1 = [6, 4], row 2 = [3, 8].

spec.title: Max pooling 2×2 stride 2
spec.aria: Four rows list the values of the top-left, top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right 2×2 windows of a 4×4 input, each with its maximum marked, and two output rows show 6, 4 and 3, 8.
